sources: catalog/production/thomas-supplement-r1/brief-2026-11-19 (托马斯动作库补充-制作说明 item 6a)

purpose.zh: 不用器械也能给手腕前侧加力，撑地时手腕更扛得住
purpose.en: Loads the front of your wrist with no gear, so it copes better when you support your weight.

text.zh: 前臂放大腿上，掌心朝上，另一只手压住掌心
text.en: Forearm on your thigh, palm up, other hand pressing on the palm

text.zh: 身体往前倾，手腕伸出膝盖外，手先垂下去。
text.en: Lean forward, let your wrist hang past the knee and the hand drop.

text.zh: 底下的手数两下卷到最高，停一下，再数三下慢慢放回；上面的手一直往下顶。
text.en: Curl up for a two count, pause, then lower for three; the top hand keeps pushing down the whole time.

text.zh: 前臂一直贴着大腿，手肘和肩膀都别动，只有手腕在走。
text.en: Forearm stays on your thigh, elbow and shoulder stay still, only the wrist moves.

commonErrors.zh: 前臂抬起来，或者用肩膀、身体去带
commonErrors.en: Lifting the forearm or heaving with your shoulder or body.

commonErrors.zh: 上面的手压太狠，手腕卷不完全程
commonErrors.en: Pressing so hard the wrist can't go all the way.

commonErrors.zh: 放回去太快，一下就掉下去
commonErrors.en: Dropping the hand back down too fast.

cautions.zh: 留两三下余力，手腕疼就停
cautions.en: Leave two or three reps in the tank, stop if your wrist hurts.

training.source: thomas-sup r2 animation tempo (8 s per rep: curl 2.2 s, hold 0.8 s, lower 3.0 s, rest 2.0 s)

thomasSupplement.doseBrief: 2–3 组 × 每侧 8–12 次，留 2–3 次余力
thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief. r2: one rep 8 s (curl 2.2 s, hold 0.8 s, lower 3.0 s, rest 2.0 s); close-up camera.

reminders.zh: 前臂贴着大腿，只有手腕在动
reminders.en: Forearm on your thigh, only the wrist moves

reminders.zh: 上面那只手一直给阻力
reminders.en: The top hand keeps pushing against it

sides.note: 一侧全部组做完再换边
